name: IndusInd Bank Ltd.
business_summary: Mid-sized private bank (vehicle finance, microfinance, cards, corporate, forex) in a turnaround after FY25-26 accounting and asset-quality problems. Promoter (Hinduja) holding is only 15.82%; FIIs 30.5%, DIIs 41.3%. Q2 FY27 net profit Rs1,242cr (screener; Moneycontrol Rs1,176cr, a swing from Rs437cr loss a year earlier) on lower credit cost; NIM was hit 7-8bp by FCNR(B) deposits, management expects recovery in Q3/Q4 and is growing gold loans while staying cautious on microfinance. Mcap Rs71k cr, ~1.05x book, ROE 1.4% (screener, TTM profit Rs3,001cr).

exposures.mechanism: +50bp credit cost: loans ~Rs3.5 lakh cr (derived) x 0.5% = Rs1,750cr vs TTM PBT ~Rs4,000cr => PBT -44%; persistence 0.5, EV/MCap 1.0 => -22; trimmed to -16 because operating buffers (PCR, floating provisions) are above average after FY26. Thin earnings make the stock the most credit-cost-convex name in the batch with IDFC First.

evidence.note: screener: Sep-2026 qtr net profit Rs1,242cr (Moneycontrol reports Rs1,176cr), TTM Rs3,001cr, mcap Rs71,113cr, P/B ~1.05, ROE 1.4%
NIM recovery expected Q3/Q4; FCNR drove 7-8bp hit (ET BFSI); plans to grow gold loans, cautious on microfinance (CNBC TV18 2026-10-26)

exposures.mechanism: MFI ~8% and cards/PL/vehicle-linked unsecured ~15% of loans (model knowledge, MFI cut sharply in FY26). +1pp delinquencies x 23% x 60% loss = 14bp of loans = Rs490cr = ~12% of PBT; persistence 0.5 => -6. Management is cautious on microfinance (CNBC TV18).

evidence.note: NIM recovery expected Q3/Q4; FCNR drove 7-8bp hit (ET BFSI); plans to grow gold loans, cautious on microfinance (CNBC TV18 2026-10-26)

exposures.mechanism: IndusInd's loan growth is low-single/low-double digit (below system); +3pp system growth adds ~+1.5pp to its own, NII +1.5% but operating leverage on a thin base => PAT +5% x persistence 0.5 => +2.5, rounded 2.0 given weaker franchise momentum.

evidence.note: screener: Sep-2026 qtr net profit Rs1,242cr (Moneycontrol reports Rs1,176cr), TTM Rs3,001cr, mcap Rs71,113cr, P/B ~1.05, ROE 1.4%
